Artist	RIOT [Monstercat]
Description	A 2018 Drumstep song by American producer duo RIOT, featured in 'Monstercat Uncaged Vol.7' and voted 1st place in Monstercat's 'Best of 2018' voting (finishing ahead of 'Crab Rave'!). The cover art features several references to other songs from their 'Dogma Resistance' LP. Map by doofyplayer.
